scenes.title: Can you use the open door?
scenes.viewerPurpose: Make formal exit unusable through prohibitive cost; Name usable choice and fair responsibility together; Give equal permission alongside unequal capacities
scenes.composition: Show an open doorway beside a person whose necessary belongings and care duties keep them from leaving. Keep the permission and the usable path as separate parts of the same situation. Place several people before the same open door with different resources and obligations.

scenes.title: The conditions behind a choice
scenes.viewerPurpose: Locate dependence in work, citizenship and care; Contrast resignation rights with survival after resignation; Keep limits from settling reciprocal obligations automatically
scenes.composition: Connect the doorway to work, citizenship and care through ordinary documents and a dependent person. Show a resignation letter beside the unanswered question of housing and income afterward. Let two people consider their different capacities to help without deciding their obligations by appearance.

scenes.title: Freedom among other people
scenes.viewerPurpose: Give language to personal choices supported by shared conditions; Return to who can cross the doorway
scenes.composition: Bring the shared supports for a usable choice into the space beside the door. End with the open doorway and the real conditions needed to cross it.
